toegepas.voor: Ons noem daardie energie wat by hom ingaan, die inset.
toegepas.na: Die energie wat by hom ingaan, noem ons die inset.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The comma between object and complement reads awkwardly; fronting the relative clause gives natural Afrikaans and matches the lesson's own 'Die deel wat ons wil hê, noem ons die nuttige uitset.'
toegepas.fout: A comma splits the object from its complement ('daardie energie wat by hom ingaan, die inset'), which reads stiffly and is not AWS punctuation.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Fronting the relative clause is the natural Afrikaans form, matches the lesson's own 'Die deel wat ons wil he, noem ons...', and keeps the meaning and the term inset intact.

toegepas.blok: Wat in elkeen gaan en wat uitkom
toegepas.voor: en bewegende lug kom uit, en die haardroër se lug is warm
toegepas.na: en bewegende lug kom uit. Die haardroër se lug is warm
toegepas.rede_vinder: Three clauses chained with 'en' read clumsily; splitting off the last one keeps the meaning and is easier for Grade 4.
toegepas.fout: Three clauses chained with 'en' in one list item make a Grade 4 reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Splitting off the last clause as its own sentence keeps every word and the meaning, and builds on rather than reverts the earlier round's change.

laat_vaar.blok: Nie alles kom uit as die deel wat ons wil hê nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'aan was' is colloquial; 'aangeskakel was' is the standard written form.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'aan was' for a lamp is plain, natural Afrikaans for a Grade 4 reader; 'aangeskakel was' is longer and only a lateral, more formal move.

vlae.blok: Wat in elkeen gaan en wat uitkom
vlae.teks: Die radio: elektrisiteit of batterye gaan in, en klank kom uit.
vlae.rede: Here the batteries themselves 'go in', while the torch line says 'n battery se energie gaan in'; the radio line may blur object and energy, but changing it would change content, so a writer should judge it.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: se gewig druk die los draadjies dan plat
laat_vaar_vorige.na: se gewig druk dan die los draadjies plat
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Dan sits more naturally straight after the verb, before the object.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Both word orders are natural Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die energie lê al die tyd in daardie twee batterye gestoor
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die energie is al die tyd in daardie twee batterye gestoor
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'lê ... gestoor' is wooden; the passive 'is ... gestoor' is the usual construction and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'lê ... gestoor' is a normal Afrikaans posture-verb construction that carries the sense of energy resting there unused; 'is gestoor' is a lateral move that flattens it.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: terug in dieselfde flitslig en druk weer
laat_vaar_vorige.na: terug in die flitslig en druk weer
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'dieselfde' occurs three times in two sentences; the flashlight is obviously the same one, and 'dieselfde twee batterye' and 'dieselfde liggie' still carry the point.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The repeated 'dieselfde' is deliberate emphasis in a test where only the batteries may change, and the original reads well, so cutting it is a lateral move that weakens the point.
